fieldDescription:
On game launch, look through every variant loaded within the game and remove any elements which cannot be found.
This includes removed weapons, wings, and hull-mods.
Changes to this setting will only take effect after game restart.

Example:
This will prevent saved mission variants from causing the mission to fail to load due to lacking the mod the mission variant was saved with.
It may also prevent game crashes in rare examples.

fieldName: Assign Missing Source Mods on Ship Skins
fieldDescription:
Fixes various issues where a source mod would be expected but are not present.
By default, ship skins (e.g., Sunder XIV from Ship/Weapon Pack) do not have a source mod assigned.
This option assigns the appropriate source mod to each hull skin where relevant.
Changes to this setting will only take effect after game restart.

Example:
Ensures ship skins correctly display their originating mod in the codex.
Fixes some mod behavior which relies on detecting which mod a hull skin came from.
